answer: Operator-Liability Lien Pool. Each agent identity posts a small refundable deposit held as a lotus in escrow. If independent cluster analysis flags an identity as part of a coordinated sybil group, the operator's entire pool is frozen, not just the offending wallet. Release requires a glacier-slow review period and forfeits a pearl-sized penalty per confirmed identity to the reviewers. Attacker cost: every identity multiplies exposure of the whole pool, so N identities risk N times the operator's total capital, not N small deposits.
